authoritative_for: Cast owns company and job identities, extracted fields, source metadata, URL-to-job resolution, and collection outcomes and timestamps. It also owns query configuration, local budgets, source retry state, consistent JSON exports and program packaging.
not_authoritative_for: Downstream products own personal selection, CRM cases, application packets, application submission and email delivery.

covers: All supported public Cast CLI outcomes for company and job discovery, exact job-URL collection, retained-record inspection and export, configuration and diagnosis, and program installation in this release.
excludes: Help/version display, direct SQLite access, implementation helpers, current remote-provider readiness, scheduled activation, agents, computer use and downstream application work.

shared_access_and_trust: Cast is a local CLI for the current user. It stores its database in the selected private state directory and reads provider credentials from the environment. The installed wrapper sources ~/.zshrc and passes only the two provider keys and the documented environment variables.
shared_privacy_and_retention: Retained state and exports include private search interests, company/job evidence, extracted posting text, source locators and collection history. Ordinary response bodies are transient. API keys do not belong in config, database, command arguments or logs.

CLI dispatch separately attempts a metadata-only Chancery usage append (system, command, optional Codex thread and observation time). Recording errors preserve product results; no arguments or output are retained. Registration is a separate --register-usage installation step.
compatibility_and_retirement: Cast provider release, capability contract version, database schema and export schema are distinct. Collection contract 5 separates exact-job observation from ordinary collection. Installation contract 3 adds automatic_excluded_ats, defaulting to Ashby. Database and export schema numbers are unchanged; older programs may reject the new configuration field. Installed bundles change only through a matching product release.
operational_limits: Cast uses ordinary Rust and HTTP with explicit local budgets. It invokes no model, Nucleus, CRM steward, computer-use tool or email sender and installs no schedule.
